name: Option 15
definition: Contracts which grant to the holder either the privilege to purchase or the privilege to sell the assets specified at a predetermined price or formula at or within a time in the future.

OptionSettlementStyle.name: Option Settlement Style
OptionSettlementStyle.definition: Specifies whether the option contract settles at the open or close of the market.

ConversionDate.name: Conversion Date
ConversionDate.definition: Deadline by which a convertible security must be converted according to the terms of the issue.

StrikePrice.name: Strike Price
StrikePrice.definition: Amount of money for which goods, services or assets are offered, sold, or bought.

MinimumExercisableQuantity.name: Minimum Exercisable Quantity
MinimumExercisableQuantity.definition: Minimum quantity of securities that must be exercised.

ConversionPeriod.name: Conversion Period
ConversionPeriod.definition: Period during which a convertible security may be converted according to the terms of the issue.

OptionStyle.name: Option Style
OptionStyle.definition: Specifies how an option can be exercised (American, European, Bermudan).

OptionType.name: Option Type
OptionType.definition: Specifies whether it is a Call option (right to purchase a specific underlying asset) or a Put option (right to sell a specific underlying asset).

StrikeValue.name: Strike Value
StrikeValue.definition: Used for derivatives. The number of shares/units for the financial instrument involved in the option trade.

StrikeMultiplier.name: Strike Multiplier
StrikeMultiplier.definition: Used for derivatives. Multiplier applied to the strike price for the purpose of calculating the settlement value.

InstrumentAssignmentMethod.name: Instrument Assignment Method
InstrumentAssignmentMethod.definition: Method under which assignment was conducted.

VersionNumber.name: Version Number
VersionNumber.definition: Number allocated by options exchanges to record that an option has undergone a change in its contract specifications (particularly adjustment of the strike price).

Standardisation.name: Standardisation
Standardisation.definition: Specifies whether the terms of the security (underlying instruments, expiration date, contract size) are defined according to the exchange specifications or whether they can be user defined.

TradingPartyRole.name: Trading Party Role
TradingPartyRole.definition: Specifies the party which is the buyer or the seller.

ContractSize.name: Contract Size
ContractSize.definition: Ratio or multiplying factor used to convert one contract into a quantity.

AdditionalUnderlyingAttributes.name: Additional Underlying Attributes
AdditionalUnderlyingAttributes.definition: Provides more information about the underlying instrument.
